title: The Thundermans: Undercover
premise_summary: The Thundermans: Undercover is an American comedy television series developed by Jed Spingarn, Sean W. Cunningham, and Marc Dworkin, serving as a spinoff and sequel to The Thundermans (2013–2018) and The Thundermans Return (2024). The series premiered on Nickelodeon on January 11, 2025, as a sneak peek following the network's alternate broadcast of an NFL Wild Card game. It later premiered officially on January 22, 2025.
